title: Images as Arrays
learning_objectives: Describe an image as an (H, W) or (H, W, C) array and index pixels by (row, column)
Avoid uint8 overflow when changing brightness and contrast
Convert between channels-last (H, W, C) and channels-first (C, H, W)
entry_point: image_info(img); adjust(img, brightness=0, contrast=1.0); to_float(img); to_uint8(x); channels_first(img); channels_last(x)
hints: `channels = img.shape[2] if img.ndim == 3 else 1`; `str(img.dtype)` gives the dtype name.

failure_feedback.advice: Convert to float before adding, then clip to [0, 255].
Scale around 128: `(img - 128) * contrast + 128`, round with np.rint, clip.
Divide by 255 for floats; multiply by 255 and round to go back.
Round with `np.rint` before converting; don't truncate.
